reset_landing.reason: COORD HANDOFF 0jz (10-19): reset landing ON (ROOT-RST standard, no opt-out). rs lands at its face in 2 plain ck flops (rs__ot_rl0 -> rs__ot_rl1) before the core (wc / rc / warm / fault); the core release moves R0 -> R0 + 2 uniformly and the die calendar (tools/s81_dv/dv_bind.py, bind table landing_reset_stages {master: 2}) opens the hop-0 gate 2 edges later too, so K = E + G - R0 and every data latency are unchanged (land_bench --rst-land 2 base PASS, mut_rlcal = uncompensated calendar FAILS). wc's clear is still asynchronous, now from rs__ot_rl1, released before the lane's first ck_f edge as before.
